product.title: Zaanse Schans Windmills & Zaandam: Countryside Electric Bike Tour

description.text: Hop on an e-bike in Amsterdam to see the Netherlands the local way, on two wheels. This small-group tour pedals to Zaanse Schans among its windmills and continues into Zaandam, where traditional wooden houses line the streets. Time on foot is built in for photos and stalls selling Dutch cheese and clogs. Bike fitting and canal-path routing stay with the guide so visitors can ride rather than plan countryside lanes independently. The outing is built for visitors who want windmill country from a city base without renting bikes alone. Stops include Zaanse Schans, Zaandam.
